turns.prompt: File an intake card: the Card component has no content slot, so a Table cannot nest inside a Card instance in Figma.

sections.heading: Problem & Context
sections.body: In the Figma component library, the Card component does not expose a content slot or instance-swap property for nested children. While the React implementation in [`design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Card/Card.jsx`](https://github.com/BilLogic/plus-uno/blob/fa924d5e17128e910c4f6b24edbb5572eccdaa74/design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/Card/Card.jsx) accepts arbitrary `children` (and `body: node`), Figma designers cannot nest a Table or other complex components inside a Card instance without detaching it.

Update the Figma Card component definition to include a component property for slot/instance swap (or a default empty nested slot container) that supports inserting structured child components like Table without breaking instance inheritance.
sections.heading: Proposed Solution
Classification
sections.body:
- **Estate:** Figma
- **Target:** components out of date (update the Figma component library)
- **Trigger type:** Bug / Improvement
- **Suggested severity:** Gated change (touches design-system library components; requires two approvals per maintain method §5.3)

sections.heading: Brief (Impact · Effort · Risk)
sections.body:
- **Impact:** High for dashboard and data-dense views; stops designers from detaching instances to place tables in cards.
- **Effort:** Low; add an instance swap / slot property to the Card component in Figma.
- **Risk:** Low; additive change to existing Card variants in the Figma component library.

args.title: Card: add content slot property for nesting components (e.g. Table) in Figma
args.summary: The Card component in the Figma library lacks a content/instance-swap slot property, preventing designers from nesting components like Table inside a Card instance without detaching.

args.message_to_user: Got it — filing the maintenance intake card now.
